newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila share index pulled down at close by PLDT.
newsitem.headline: Manila share index pulled down at close by PLDT.

text.p: * PLDT slips, other blue chips rising
The Philippine equities market ended another listless session in negative territory with index heavyweight PLDT dragging the index down by 1.91 points, brokers said.

"PLDT pulled down the market, but most big-cap issues are doing pretty well," Felix Barrientos, a trader at ING Baring Securities, said. PLDT lost another 10 pesos to 1,565 pesos following the continued weakness of its ADR abroad.
However, other blue chips strengthened on fresh foreign buying, Irving Ackerman, president of I. Ackerman & Co said.

"San Miguel B broke the 100 peso mark after many months. This to me is a bellwether that foreign money is starting to look at the Philippines again," Ackerman said. Another blue chip which inched up was Meralco B gaining one peso to 194 pesos.
The composite index slipped for the third straight session to close at 3,063.74 points.
Lending excitement to an otherwise sleepy market was PDCP Bank which gained 5.50 pesos to 30.50 pesos after it announced a merger plan with AsianBank.- RAMONCITO DELA CRUZ 63 2 841-8938
